column1: # Upstream components of motanka-qt6, Qt 6 for the Stack on Ubuntu 24.04.
# Same format as stack/components.tsv (see the comment there); build "qt"
# is a Qt submodule built by packaging/motanka-qt6/debian/qt6-build.sh, in
# file order, each against the ones before it. The package field names
# motanka-qt6; the build splits the files into motanka-qt6 (runtime) and
# motanka-qt6-dev (build files, never published) by path.
# Spike S1 addendum (design.md): Quickshell 0.3.2 needs Qt >= 6.6; 24.04
# has 6.4.2, 26.04 has 6.10.2 in its archive. So every line is noble only,
# and packaging/motanka-qt6/suites skips the package for resolute.
# Download, verify and pin: stack/fetch-sources --components stack/qt6-components.tsv
